Batch 48 authoring is complete. The A and B pages, 17-item manifest, proof contracts, source coverage, cross-batch evidence, notes, and 17 `ready` Step-1 records are in place. All records have `owner:false`; a fresh check confirms all 17 are hash-current and closed.

Final scoped checks passed: dependency levels, manifest dependencies, depcheck, content policy, precheck, strict proof contracts, proof layout (17 items, 42 steps, no defects), rendercheck, and source coverage. The coverage checklist reports 28 harvested results with no errors. Source fetch reports 4/6 entries fetched and all 6 resolved; the two Springer entries document the fetch failures and alternatives. No mathematical claims were dropped. Coverage includes the [Law–Stuart–Zygalakis manuscript](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1506.07825v1), [Mandel–Cobb–Beezley paper](https://arxiv.org/pdf/0901.2951v2), and inspected [Evensen et al. textbook](https://link.springer.com/book/10.1007/978-3-030-96709-3).

Key files: [A page](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/library/bayesian-computational-statistics/data-assimilation-variational-and-ensemble-methods.md), [B page](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/library/bayesian-computational-statistics/data-assimilation-variational-and-ensemble-methods-examples.md), [batch manifest](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/bayesian-computational-statistics-62-batch-48.pages.json), and [handoff notes](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/bayesian-computational-statistics-62-batch-48.notes.md).
